title: 第十五章 觉醒一第十六章 觉醒二
lines: 四人心神巨震，能无声无息的出现，实力自然是远超于他们。
夜天云回身望去，两位岩忍站立在身后，似笑非笑的望着自己，注意到标志性的上忍马甲，夜天云暗叹事情脱离了掌控。
他们脸上虽带着笑意，但眼中却满含杀意，还带有一丝震惊。刚才的一切他们自然看在眼中，夜天云杀人时好似喝水吃饭一般平常，没有大量的杀戮是做不来的。
但两人毕竟是上忍，但眼睁睁看着手下被杀是绝对不可能的，上忍有着上忍的骄傲。
“小鬼，你是谁？”平次阴沉的问道。
“不关你的事。”夜天云冷冷的回答，现在只有战斗一条路，也就不必回答。
“天云。。。”长门发觉事情不妙，正想劝阻夜天云时，他的话却被岩忍逼了回去。
“臭小鬼，想好怎么死了么！？”平次也不在掩饰自己的杀意，属于上忍的强大杀气立刻显露出来。
从未接触过杀气的长门三人如堕冰窟，手脚冰凉，仿佛只要动一根手指，便会立刻身首异处，三人十分惊恐，甚至出现了一丝幻觉，但仍勉强维持着意识。
看着视自己的杀气于无物的夜天云，平次心里震惊更甚，不过下一刻，脸上泛起了充满杀意的狞笑，道：“佐佐木，你上还是我上？”
“我没有欺负孩子的兴趣。”
话中虽有着淡淡的讽刺，但平次也不在意，弓腰屈膝，双脚瞬间发力蹬向地面，“嘭”的一声，竟泛起音爆之声，空气中泛起一丝残像，只是一瞬间，拳头已经到达了夜天云的面前。
只是，在拳头即将接触到夜天云的瞬间，入手之处竟然是空无一物，夜天云诡异的消失在视野之中。
平次的心中一紧，余光一扫，夜天云不知何时已出现在了背后，磨砺了百战的上忍的反射神经十分迅捷，立刻单脚为支点，向身后回扫，伴起呼呼风响。
只是，夜天云的身影再度诡异的消失，平次停下来攻击，凝神望去，夜天云却已立在两丈开外。
“好诡异的身法。”佐佐木瞳孔一缩，“不像是以直线为轨迹的瞬身术，不是闪电般的迅速，更像是鬼魅一般的飘。”佐佐木一语道破了夜天云身法的诡异。
“鬼闪都能瞬间做出反应，果然是上忍。”夜天云心里有些无奈，但表情依旧冷静，与人生死相搏，决不能露出胆怯。
前世，夜天云战斗天赋极高，思索数载，结众家之所长，创立了这套步伐。
鬼闪的原理不难，只是利用视线的盲点进行移动，但重生后，夜天云的身体素质有破而后立的征兆，加上步伐的诡异，给人闪烁间飘移不定的感觉。
“平次，这个小鬼不一般。”佐佐木的心思缜密，已看穿了鬼闪，出言提醒。
平次没有回答，只是脸色阴晴不定。
突然，平次动了，与之前的气势截然不同，若之前是狼一般的凶悍，此时的他便如饿虎扑食，拳风凛冽，伴起呼啸风声，气势压人。
夜天云不敢硬接，只以鬼步躲避，身法游走盘旋，丈许方圆之内，宛若幽灵，趋退若神。
平次一记扫堂腿直攻夜天云的下盘，夜天云后空翻滚，如乳燕还巢，轻盈灵动，脚尖着地后却见平次已经横肘而击，小腿轻弹，弯下腰身，迅疾若风，竟从平次的腋下窜将而过，反手一刀挥出，潇洒无比。
平次依旧冷静，借着肘击的惯性顺势回身，左手张开，竟然空手入白刃，将夜天云的长刀夹在掌中，右腿膝撞，顶向夜天云腹部。
夜天云借着平次左手的力量翻身而起，避开了膝撞，右脚凌空踢向平次的手腕，平次左手一松，夜天云抽出太刀，后跃丈许。
“火遁。炎弹。”夜天云左手闪动了几下，速度不快，但在场众人却无不惊叹。
“单手结印！”平次首次得见，竟愣在原地。
就在这瞬间失神之际，夜天云的忍术已经准备妥当，虽说只是C级忍术，但夜天云本身具备火属性，火球从口中吐出，颜色却是深红色。
待到平次缓过神来，火球已经近在咫尺，肌肤感受到了灼烧感，平次心中愤怒，全身爆发出强烈的查克拉波动。
“轰”，火球击中了目标，周围数米被火舌笼罩，爆炸声轰鸣。
看到夜天云的忍术成功奏效，长门三人又惊又喜，他们从未见过夜天云真正的实力，却没想他竟能击败上忍，只是，他们心中忽然涌起一股陌生感，无论是谈笑杀人还是激战上忍，夜天云都与平时判若两人。
不过他们倒是也想左了，若不是鬼闪的轨迹诡异，飘忽不定，以夜天云如今只是堪比中忍的实力，断不是上忍一合之敌。
小南看着单手持刀而立的夜天云，心中闪过一丝黯然，虽是近在咫尺，却如天涯相隔。
夜天云依旧一脸凝重，他的查克拉控制力已使得出单手结印，精神力自然又增长少许，自然依稀感受得到灰尘烟火中暴动的查克拉。
content_en:
The four of them were greatly shaken. Being able to appear silently means that their strength is naturally far superior to theirs.
Ye Tianyun turned around and saw two rock ninjas standing behind him, looking at him with a half-smile but not a smile. He noticed the iconic jounin vest, and Ye Tianyun secretly sighed that things were out of control.
Although they had smiles on their faces, their eyes were filled with murderous intent and a hint of shock. They naturally saw everything that happened just now. When Ye Tianyun killed someone, it was as normal as drinking water and eating. He couldn't do it without a lot of killing.
But the two of them are jounin after all, but it is absolutely impossible to watch their subordinates being killed. The jounin has the pride of being a jounin.
"Kid, who are you?" Heiji asked gloomily.
"It's none of your business." Ye Tianyun replied coldly. There was only one way to fight now, so there was no need to answer.
"Tianyun..." Nagato realized that something was not right, and when he was about to dissuade Ye Tianyun, his words were forced back by Iwa Ninja.
"You brat, have you figured out how to die!?" Heiji no longer concealed his murderous intention, and the powerful murderous intention of a Jonin was immediately revealed.
The three Nagatos, who had never been exposed to murderous aura, felt as if they had fallen into an ice cave. Their hands and feet were cold, as if they would immediately be dismembered if they moved a finger. The three of them were very frightened and even had a trace of hallucinations, but they still barely maintained their consciousness.
Looking at Ye Tianyun who ignored his murderous intent, Heiji was even more shocked. But the next moment, a murderous smile appeared on his face and he said: "Sasaki, are you going to go up or should I go up?"
"I have no interest in bullying children."
Although there was a hint of sarcasm in his words, Heiji didn't care. He bowed his waist and knees, and instantly kicked his feet to the ground. With a "bang", there was a sonic boom, and there was an afterimage in the air. In just a moment, his fist had reached in front of Ye Tianyun.
However, at the moment when his fist was about to touch Ye Tianyun, there was nothing there, and Ye Tianyun mysteriously disappeared from sight.
Heiji's heart tightened, and he glanced out of the corner of his eye. Ye Tianyun had appeared behind him at some point. The jounin's reflexes, which had been honed for hundreds of battles, were very fast. He immediately used one foot as a fulcrum and swept back behind him, accompanied by the sound of whistling wind.
However, Ye Tianyun's figure disappeared strangely again. Heiji stopped to attack and looked intently, but Ye Tianyun was already standing two feet away.
"What a weird movement technique." Sasaki's pupils shrank, "It's not like a teleportation technique with a straight line as a trajectory, it's not as fast as lightning, it's more like floating like a ghost." Sasaki revealed the weirdness of Ye Tianyun's movement technique in one word.
"Ghost Flash can react instantly, he is indeed a Jonin." Ye Tianyun felt a little helpless, but his expression remained calm. In a life-and-death fight, he must not show timidity.
In his previous life, Ye Tianyun had extremely high fighting talent. He thought about it for several years and combined the strengths of many families to create this routine.
The principle of ghost flash is not difficult. It just uses the blind spot of the sight to move. However, after rebirth, Ye Tianyun's physical fitness showed signs of breaking and then standing up again. Coupled with the weird pace, it gave people the feeling of drifting between flashes.
"Heiji, this kid is unusual." Sasaki was thoughtful and had seen through the ghost flash, so he reminded him.
Heiji didn't answer, but his expression was uncertain.
Suddenly, Heiji moved, and his momentum was completely different from before. If he was as fierce as a wolf before, now he was like a hungry tiger pouncing on food, the wind of his fists was fierce, accompanied by the roaring wind, and his momentum was overwhelming.
Ye Tianyun did not dare to meet him head-on, so he only used ghost steps to dodge, his body movements wandering and circling, like a ghost within a radius of about ten feet, retreating like a god.
Heiji swept his leg directly to attack Ye Tianyun's lower body. Ye Tianyun rolled back in the air, like a baby swallow returning to its nest, light and agile. After landing on his toes, he saw that Heiji had already struck with his elbow. He flicked his calf, bent down, and was as fast as the wind. He passed by Heiji's armpit and swung the knife with his backhand, extremely cool.
Heiji remained calm and used the inertia of the elbow strike to turn around. He opened his left hand and unexpectedly entered the blade with his bare hands. He caught Ye Tianyun's long knife in his palm and hit his right leg with his knee, pushing it against Ye Tianyun's abdomen.
Ye Tianyun relied on the power of Heiji's left hand to stand up, avoiding the knee collision, and kicked Heiji's wrist with his right foot in the air. Heiji let go of his left hand, and Ye Tianyun drew out his sword and jumped back a few feet.
"Fire Escape. Flame Bullet." Ye Tianyun flashed his left hand a few times, not very fast, but everyone present was amazed.
"One-hand seal!" Heiji was stunned when he saw it for the first time.
At this moment of loss of consciousness, Ye Tianyun's ninjutsu was ready. Although it was only a C-level ninjutsu, Ye Tianyun itself had the attribute of fire. The fireball spit out from his mouth was dark red in color.
By the time Heiji calmed down, the fireball was already close at hand, and his skin felt a burning sensation. Heiji was angry in his heart, and strong chakra fluctuations erupted all over his body.
"Boom", the fireball hit the target, and the surrounding area was enveloped in flames for several meters, and the explosion roared.
Seeing that Ye Tianyun's ninjutsu worked successfully, the three of Nagato were surprised and happy. They had never seen Ye Tianyun's true strength, but they did not expect that he could defeat the Jonin. However, a strange feeling suddenly surged in their hearts. Whether he was talking and laughing about killing people or fighting fiercely with the Jonin, Ye Tianyun was completely different from usual.
However, they also thought wrong. If it weren't for the strange and erratic trajectory of the ghost flash, Ye Tianyun's strength was only comparable to that of a chuunin, and he would definitely not be an enemy of a jounin.
Xiaonan looked at Ye Tianyun, who was standing with a knife in one hand, and a hint of sadness flashed in his heart. Although they were so close, they felt like they were worlds apart.
Ye Tianyun still had a solemn expression on his face. His chakra control had allowed him to form one-hand seals, and his mental power naturally increased a little. Naturally, he could vaguely feel the surging chakra in the dust and fireworks.
